name: Data Union Capital International Holdings Group Limited
summary: Data Union Capital International Holdings Group Limited, founded in 2006 and based in Kowloon, is an investment holding company that makes and trades aluminum electrolytic capacitors in Hong Kong, China, Japan and Macau. It sells chip and radial lead types and trades electronic components, including integrated circuits, diodes, transistors and LED lighting. It was formerly Vertical International Holdings Limited until May 2025.
